module.summary: Borrowed binary input cursor with checked, failure-atomic reads.
module.long_description: Borrowed binary input cursor with checked, failure-atomic reads.

purpose.primary: Read structured values from a borrowed byte slice without advancing beyond its bounds or consuming input on failed reads.

c_pain.summary: C binary parsers commonly mix pointer arithmetic, length checks, cursor mutation, alignment, and endianness at every call site.
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: Pointer increments and casts make initial parsers short and fast.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Every field repeats subtle security-sensitive arithmetic and rollback behavior.

zig_response.summary: A borrowed slice and cursor are encapsulated behind checked reads with explicit byte order and confined sub-readers.
guarantees_made_visible: child readers cannot exceed their assigned slice
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: decide whether trailing bytes are valid
